content.text:
I can't give you the beat/miss figures. I found AMD's guidance for all four quarters, but not the actual non-GAAP gross profit for any of them. Without the actuals I can't work out a beat or miss, or the average.

**What I could confirm (the guided side)**

The last four reported quarters as of 16 May 2025 are Q2'24, Q3'24, Q4'24 and Q1'25. I checked each guidance figure by searching for the exact wording, and each search matched only the earnings-release 8-K expected to contain it. I couldn't open the documents, so this confirms the wording but I didn't see the surrounding text. Implied guided non-GAAP gross profit is the revenue midpoint times the guided non-GAAP gross margin.

| Quarter | Guided revenue (midpoint) | Guided non-GAAP GM | Implied guided non-GAAP gross profit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q2'24 | ~$5.7B | ~53% | ~$3,021 million |
| Q3'24 | ~$6.7B | ~53.5% | ~$3,585 million |
| Q4'24 | ~$7.5B | ~54% | ~$4,050 million |
| Q1'25 | ~$7.1B | ~54% | ~$3,834 million |

**What's missing (the actual side)**
- **Actual non-GAAP gross profit:** Not found with these tools. It's a non-GAAP number, so it isn't in AMD's structured financial data. The full-text search only shows which filings contain a phrase, not the text itself. Searches for "non-GAAP gross margin was 53%" and "…54%" found nothing, so the wording is probably different.
- **Actual revenue:** I only have Q1'25 at $7,438 million, from the 10-Q filed 2025-05-07. Q3'24 revenue ($6,819 million) came only from a 10-Q filed after the 16 May 2025 cutoff, so I didn't use it. I didn't retrieve Q2'24 or Q4'24 revenue.

So I can't give the "QX - $XXX million (X.X % BEAT/MISS)" lines or the average without guessing. To finish this, the next step is to read the non-GAAP gross profit reconciliation table in each actuals release listed below. Then the beat or miss is the actual figure minus the guided figure above, and the % is that difference divided by the guided figure.

**Sources**
- 8-K (Q1'24 earnings, guidance for Q2'24), filed 2024-04-30, accession 0000002488-24-000054
- 8-K (Q2'24 earnings, actuals for Q2'24 and guidance for Q3'24), filed 2024-07-30, accession 0000002488-24-000121
- 8-K (Q3'24 earnings, actuals for Q3'24 and guidance for Q4'24), filed 2024-10-29, accession 0000002488-24-000161
- 8-K (Q4'24 earnings, actuals for Q4'24 and guidance for Q1'25), filed 2025-02-04, accession 0000002488-25-000009
- 8-K (Q1'25 earnings, actuals for Q1'25), filed 2025-05-06, accession 0000002488-25-000045
- 10-Q (Q1'25 revenue), filed 2025-05-07, accession 0000002488-25-000047
